description: The Spanish drought-monitoring team publishes historical meteorological drought indices through a CSIC web portal. The original release contains seven weekly indices on a 1.1 km grid for 1961–2014; the current service states that its historical database starts in 1961 and is updated annually. A separate monitor updates current conditions weekly. Users can view maps and obtain point series or netCDF4 grids freely under the Open Database Licence 1.0. These national observations can drive drought and irrigation-demand simulations or assess water-supply exposure. Limited station coverage and index choice affect comparisons, and the latest complete historical year was not checked. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Spain high-resolution drought indices
